title: Ph-triazole as a therapeutic agent for pancreatic cancer: Synthesis, in silico, and in vitro evaluation.
authors: Zhang, Ningbo; Li, Xingxing; Li, Fangyuan; Jin, Jianjiang; Zheng, Ting; Zhou, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ph-triazole对胰腺癌的治疗潜力，涉及P53蛋白的分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The current study investigated the therapeutic potential of Ph-triazole in silico and in vitro against pancreatic cancer. Common targets between Ph-triazole and pancreatic cancer, notably P53 protein, were identified using the venny 2.1.0 tool and imported into the String database to construct the protein-protein network. Box plot revealed that the most prominent hub gene TP53 is strongly up-regulated in pancreatic tumor tissues (N = 179) compared to normal tissue samples (N = 171), and stage plots confirmed that its upregulation is found during all four stages of the disease. Survival analysis of the pancreatic cancer patients revealed a strong correlation between TP53 gene overexpression and low overall survival and disease-free survival. Molecular docking showed that Ph-triazole exhibits a strong binding affinity for P53 protein. In vitro data also confirmed the anti-proliferative effect of Ph-triazole in pancreatic cancer cell models. Therefore, Ph-triazole can act as an anti-proliferative agent for pancreatic cancer and needs to be investigated further by in vivo studies.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）实验，探讨了Ph-triazole对胰腺癌的治疗潜力。利用venny 2.1.0工具识别出Ph-triazole与胰腺癌之间的共同靶点，特别是P53蛋白，并将其导入String数据库以构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。箱线图显示，与正常组织样本（N = 171）相比，胰腺肿瘤组织（N = 179）中最显著的枢纽基因TP53强烈上调，且分期图证实其上调存在于疾病的四个阶段。胰腺癌患者的生存分析显示，TP53基因过表达与总生存期和无病生存期较低之间存在强相关性。分子对接结果表明，Ph-triazole对P53蛋白具有强结合亲和力。体外数据也证实了Ph-triazole在胰腺癌细胞模型中的抗增殖作用。因此，Ph-triazole可作为胰腺癌的抗增殖剂，并需通过体内研究进一步验证。
